conflicts.quote: manufacturer: 'Ascorbyl Palmitate' vs dm and Rossmann: 'ASCOBYL PALMITATE'; dm/Rossmann also 'QUATERNIUM- 80' (space) vs manufacturer 'Quaternium-80'
conflicts.resolution: Non-material. Same list length (23) and order in all three sources; the retailer strings are one shared supplier-feed typo/space. Manufacturer spelling used.

canonicalReason: Manufacturer DE page (dejangarz.com) shows the full 23-item list for 'The Foundation Shampoo' 300 ml; dm.de and Rossmann (both GTIN 4270004570106) agree on order and content except a shared typo (Ascobyl / 'Quaternium- 80'). Unchanged vs v1.3 capture (2026-08-10, manufacturer page). Manufacturer spelling adopted.
normalization: Split the canonical INCI on ',' (or '|' / '•' separators where the source uses them; dm renders a non-breaking hyphen as '|' inside names, e.g. 'COCO|GLUCOSIDE' = 'Coco-Glucoside'); per ingredient: trim, collapse internal whitespace, merge split synonym entries (e.g. 'Aqua (Water, Eau)' stays one item), strip trailing full stop; canonicalInci keeps the published capitalisation/asterisks; for the hash each item is lower-cased; items joined with '|' and sha256 over the UTF-8 string.
notes: Catalog name 'Dejan Garz Shampoo' = 'The Foundation Shampoo' (300 ml, GTIN 4270004570106, same as v1.3 formula-source). Not 'The Sensitive' shampoo (dm 12,95 EUR, separate product).
Manufacturer page itself shows no GTIN; GTIN anchored by dm + Rossmann.
dm.de showed the shampoo as 'Momentan nicht lieferbar' (online) on 2026-10-09 while the conditioner etc. are 'Lieferbar'; Rossmann lists it as lieferbar. Not a delisting, just worth watching.

Claim-INCI check: Panthenol, Glycerin, Sodium Hyaluronate present; 'rückfettend' complex = Glyceryl Oleate / Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate / Lecithin (no named ingredient missing). Page claims 'natürliche Reinigung' on a Sodium Laureth Sulfate base - marketing wording, not an ingredient claim. No conflict.
Manufacturer page claim 'Regulates Oil Production on the Scalp' is a benefit claim without a named active; Salicylic Acid is present (position 7).
